mapper.select: SELECT s.sn_id,s.sn_code,s.item_id,s.item_code,s.item_name,s.batch_code, u.workorder_id,u.current_task_id,u.unit_state,u.assembly_feedback_id,u.created_at,u.updated_at, w.workorder_code,w.workorder_name,w.status AS order_status, o.route_id,o.route_code,o.route_name,o.released_at,o.release_user_id FROM wm_sn s LEFT JOIN pro_execution_unit u ON u.sn_id=s.sn_id LEFT JOIN pro_execution_order o ON o.workorder_id=u.workorder_id LEFT JOIN pro_workorder w ON w.workorder_id=u.workorder_id WHERE s.sn_code=#{snCode} LIMIT 2

SELECT e.task_id,e.normal_step_no,e.process_id,e.process_code,e.process_name,e.step_kind,e.task_kind, e.source_disposition_id,e.assigned_user_id,e.started_by,e.actual_started_at,e.ended_by,e.actual_ended_at, t.task_code,t.task_name,t.status,t.workstation_id,t.workstation_code,t.workstation_name FROM pro_execution_task e JOIN pro_task t ON t.task_id=e.task_id AND t.workorder_id=e.workorder_id LEFT JOIN pro_execution_disposition d ON d.disposition_id=e.source_disposition_id WHERE e.workorder_id=#{workorderId} AND (e.task_kind='NORMAL' OR (e.task_kind='REWORK' AND d.sn_id=#{snId})) ORDER BY CASE WHEN e.task_kind='NORMAL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,e.normal_step_no,e.actual_started_at,e.task_id

SELECT i.input_id,i.task_id,i.feedback_id,i.item_id,l.item_code,l.item_name, i.source_batch_code,i.quantity,i.unit_of_measure,i.used_by,i.used_at, i.material_stock_id,i.consume_line_id,h.record_id AS consume_record_id,h.consume_date,h.status AS consume_status FROM pro_execution_input i JOIN pro_execution_unit u ON u.sn_id=i.sn_id JOIN pro_execution_task e ON e.task_id=i.task_id AND e.workorder_id=u.workorder_id JOIN pro_feedback f ON f.record_id=i.feedback_id AND f.workorder_id=u.workorder_id AND f.task_id=i.task_id JOIN wm_item_consume_line l ON l.line_id=i.consume_line_id AND l.item_id=i.item_id JOIN wm_item_consume h ON h.record_id=l.record_id AND h.workorder_id=u.workorder_id AND h.task_id=i.task_id WHERE i.sn_id=#{snId} AND u.workorder_id=#{workorderId} ORDER BY i.used_at,i.input_id

SELECT i.inspection_id,i.round_no,i.task_id,i.ipqc_id,i.source_disposition_id,i.produce_line_id, q.ipqc_code,q.ipqc_name,q.ipqc_type,q.template_id,q.check_result,q.inspect_date,q.inspector,q.status, q.quantity_check,q.quantity_qualified,q.quantity_unqualified,h.record_id AS produce_record_id, CASE WHEN h.record_id IS NOT NULL THEN p.batch_code END AS produced_batch_code, CASE WHEN h.record_id IS NOT NULL THEN p.quantity_produce END AS quantity_produce FROM pro_execution_inspection i JOIN pro_execution_unit u ON u.sn_id=i.sn_id JOIN pro_execution_task e ON e.task_id=i.task_id AND e.workorder_id=u.workorder_id JOIN qc_ipqc q ON q.ipqc_id=i.ipqc_id AND q.workorder_id=u.workorder_id AND q.task_id=i.task_id LEFT JOIN wm_product_produce_line p ON p.line_id=i.produce_line_id LEFT JOIN wm_product_produce h ON h.record_id=p.record_id AND h.workorder_id=u.workorder_id AND h.task_id=i.task_id WHERE i.sn_id=#{snId} AND u.workorder_id=#{workorderId} ORDER BY i.round_no,i.inspection_id

SELECT line_id,index_id,index_code,index_name,index_type,check_method,qc_tool, unit_of_measure,stander_val,threshold_max,threshold_min,cr_quantity,maj_quantity,min_quantity,remark,attr1,attr2 FROM qc_ipqc_line WHERE ipqc_id=#{ipqcId} ORDER BY line_id
SELECT record_id,line_id,defect_name,defect_level,defect_quantity,remark FROM qc_defect_record WHERE qc_type='IPQC' AND qc_id=#{ipqcId} ORDER BY record_id

SELECT d.disposition_id,d.inspection_id,d.decision,d.reason,d.decided_by,d.decided_at, e.task_id AS rework_task_id FROM pro_execution_disposition d JOIN pro_execution_unit u ON u.sn_id=d.sn_id JOIN pro_execution_inspection i ON i.inspection_id=d.inspection_id AND i.sn_id=d.sn_id LEFT JOIN pro_execution_task e ON e.source_disposition_id=d.disposition_id AND e.workorder_id=u.workorder_id AND e.task_kind='REWORK' WHERE d.sn_id=#{snId} AND u.workorder_id=#{workorderId} ORDER BY d.decided_at,d.disposition_id

SELECT x.task_id,x.packed_by,x.packed_at,x.package_line_id,l.package_id,p.package_code FROM pro_execution_pack x JOIN pro_execution_unit u ON u.sn_id=x.sn_id JOIN pro_execution_task e ON e.task_id=x.task_id AND e.workorder_id=u.workorder_id LEFT JOIN wm_package_line l ON l.line_id=x.package_line_id AND l.workorder_id=u.workorder_id LEFT JOIN wm_package p ON p.package_id=l.package_id WHERE x.sn_id=#{snId} AND u.workorder_id=#{workorderId}

SELECT f.record_id,f.task_id,f.feedback_time,f.user_name,f.nick_name,f.status,f.quantity_feedback FROM pro_execution_unit u JOIN pro_feedback f ON f.record_id=u.assembly_feedback_id AND f.workorder_id=u.workorder_id JOIN pro_execution_task e ON e.task_id=f.task_id AND e.workorder_id=u.workorder_id WHERE u.sn_id=#{snId} AND u.workorder_id=#{workorderId}
mapper.sql:
FROM ( SELECT i.sn_id,MIN(i.used_at) AS first_used_at,MAX(i.used_at) AS last_used_at,COUNT(*) AS input_count FROM pro_execution_input i JOIN pro_execution_unit iu ON iu.sn_id=i.sn_id JOIN pro_execution_task ie ON ie.task_id=i.task_id AND ie.workorder_id=iu.workorder_id JOIN pro_feedback f ON f.record_id=i.feedback_id AND f.workorder_id=iu.workorder_id AND f.task_id=i.task_id JOIN wm_item_consume_line l ON l.line_id=i.consume_line_id AND l.item_id=i.item_id JOIN wm_item_consume h ON h.record_id=l.record_id AND h.workorder_id=iu.workorder_id AND h.task_id=i.task_id WHERE i.item_id=#{itemId} AND i.source_batch_code=#{batchCode} AND BINARY i.source_batch_code=BINARY #{batchCode} GROUP BY i.sn_id ) matching JOIN pro_execution_unit u ON u.sn_id=matching.sn_id JOIN wm_sn s ON s.sn_id=u.sn_id JOIN pro_execution_order o ON o.workorder_id=u.workorder_id JOIN pro_workorder w ON w.workorder_id=u.workorder_id JOIN pro_execution_task current_task ON current_task.task_id=u.current_task_id AND current_task.workorder_id=u.workorder_id JOIN pro_task t ON t.task_id=current_task.task_id AND t.workorder_id=current_task.workorder_id
WHERE (o.release_user_id=#{actorId} OR current_task.assigned_user_id=#{actorId})
mapper.select:
SELECT s.sn_id,s.sn_code,s.item_id,s.item_code,s.item_name,s.batch_code, u.workorder_id,u.current_task_id,u.unit_state,w.workorder_code,w.workorder_name,w.status AS order_status, matching.first_used_at,matching.last_used_at,matching.input_count
ORDER BY u.sn_id LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
